_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate and score still inside 63-70 make HOLD the skilled call; cold funding/CVD/reserves are pressure not a confirmed breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — analyst explicit Hope/HOLD; narrative intake drop and blowoff analog more distributional without a forward phase vote
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed stays inside 63-70 and BTC holds range without a fresh 30d momentum low
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks under 63 with momentum_30d and CVD still suppressed, or reclaims above 70 with funding flipping positive and 30d momentum turning up
